0022600167.text: The Houston Rockets (6-1, second in the Southwest and second in the West) host the Boston Celtics (5-1, second in the Atlantic and third in the East) in Houston's eighth game of the season, with the Rockets holding a 3-0 home record and having won their last game, while the Celtics have won five straight. Steven Adams is out for Houston with a calf strain, and Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Reed Sheppard (back) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while Boston will be without Devin Carter (illness) and Mitchell Robinson (rest), both listed as out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the most recent meeting on February 4, 2026, in Houston, a 114-93 Rockets loss.
